answer.rationale: The cost mandate favors switching, and memory_c2 supports low-cost supply, but the 14-day expiry, no auto-renew, 94% loading, and zero buffer make a primary-vendor switch likely to increase delivery risk. Incumbent renewal/negotiation cannot meet the 18% cut because price reopening was refused; deferral is unsafe with a critical expiring primary contract. I intend to add a second source as a guarded qualification path to remove single-point failure and create pricing leverage without immediately migrating volume. I want memory_c2 verified because it is the main evidence for switching and could conceal onboarding, quality, or allocation risks not reflected in the consolidated note.
